messages:
Arun (Support): Solaris staging failing during onboarding checks — embed API returning 429/502s. Customer reported blocks completing checklist. Logs: 

Arun (Support): ```
2026-03-25T08:14:02Z embed-svc status=429 tenant=solaris env=staging
2026-03-25T08:14:17Z proxy status=502 upstream=embed-svc tenant=solaris
```

alert-bot: Incident created SOL-INC-711 (priority: P2) - elevated embed errors for tenant solaris (staging).

Leah - CSM: Leah here. Solaris is in trial conversion week. Are we seeing prod impact? What's customer tone?

Arun (Support): Only staging so far. Error rate ~20% for 15m. Customer engineer says "onboarding blocked" and asked for a plan.

Maya - CS Ops: Looping SRE. I'll draft comms once we have mitigation. Ravi, any obvious cause?

Ravi (SRE): No deploys for Solaris in 4d. Traces show a CI job hammering staging with many tiny concurrent requests (~95 concurrency). Rate limiter tripped and backend queues spilled causing 502s. Quick mitigation: temp bump per-tenant concurrency and mute alerts. Long-term: discuss quota and batching.

Leah - CSM: Proposed customer message: "Hi Priya — we've identified transient embed failures in your staging run caused by a CI burst. We've applied a temporary stabilization and are monitoring. Prod is unaffected. ETA to revert: 45m. Would you like us to rerun onboarding checks or schedule a short enablement session to optimize your runner?" Thoughts?

Jo (Enablement): Offer a 15-20m pairing to walk through batching/backoff — that'll reduce friction and give us feedback for docs.

Ravi (SRE): Applied temp bump at 08:22 UTC (concurrency 12->48) and muted alerts for 45m. Error rate dropped to ~3% within 6m.

Maya - CS Ops: Sending comms to Solaris now. I'll add a renewal note flagging this as a transient onboarding friction and link SOL-INC-711.

Arun (Support): Customer reply: "Staging is stable, thanks. We'll schedule the pairing." Tone: relieved.

Leah - CSM: Marking resolved for now. Follow-ups: (1) CS Ops to add checklist item: staging embed >10% during onboarding -> escalate support->CS, offer pairing, log sentiment; (2) Enablement to schedule pairing; (3) If customer requests permanent quota, open ops/pricing ticket and update renewal risk.

Jo (Enablement): I'll DM Leah with two slot options and create a short batching checklist to attach.

alert-bot: SOL-INC-711 status -> monitoring (updates: 08:28 UTC, 08:35 UTC).

Maya - CS Ops: Added checklist entry and linked incident. Closing loop unless we see regressions.
